title: Basecamp Retail — competitive displacement (Fireflies)
description: Prospect comparing against Fireflies: wants analysis with citations, not transcription alone. Legal fears hallucinated notes in deal records.

transcript.speaker: Rep
transcript.text: Morning Alex, I know you're comparing us against Fireflies so let's get right into it.

transcript.speaker: Prospect
transcript.text: Yeah, Fireflies is fine but it's basically just transcription, we want actual analysis.

transcript.speaker: Rep
transcript.text: That's the gap, we go past transcription into objections, intent scoring and next steps with citations.

transcript.speaker: Rep
transcript.text: Every claim in the summary links back to the exact line in the transcript it came from, so nothing is made up.

transcript.speaker: Prospect
transcript.text: That's actually a real concern for us, our legal team is worried about hallucinated notes going into deal records.

transcript.speaker: Prospect
transcript.text: If we can't trust the output we can't roll this out company wide.

transcript.speaker: Rep
transcript.text: Understood, that's a blocking concern for us too internally, which is why we gate on it before anything ships.

transcript.speaker: Prospect
transcript.text: Okay, what about pricing, we're currently paying per seat for three separate tools.

transcript.speaker: Rep
transcript.text: We'd consolidate that into one API-metered bill, usually cheaper once you add up what you're paying today.

transcript.speaker: Prospect
transcript.text: Send me a comparison and I'll take it to procurement next week. Intent is to replace Fireflies if the receipts story holds.

transcript.speaker: Rep
transcript.text: Sounds good, I'll follow up with a side by side and a proposed start date by end of day Friday.

followUpEmail.subject: Basecamp × OpenGong — Fireflies comparison + proposed start
followUpEmail.body:
Alex —

Thanks for the candid comparison against Fireflies.

Attached: a side-by-side on transcription-only vs deal notes with citations, plus how our gate blocks unproven claims before anything ships (addresses legal's hallucination concern).

Also included: API-metered pricing vs per-seat across three tools, and a proposed start date.

Happy to join procurement next week.

— OpenGong Lite
